name: Smart Sales Dashboard
author: SM DIGITAL

sections.description:
Know what’s selling. Understand your store at a glance.

Smart Sales Dashboard brings your WooCommerce sales numbers and product performance into one dedicated WordPress admin screen. Check recent sales, explore your best sellers, and identify products or categories that may need attention – without jumping between multiple reports.

Your sales overview, in one place

  • Sales at a glance: View net order sales, paid-order count, average order value, and net units sold.
  • Flexible time periods: Switch between the last 7, 30, and 90 days.
  • Revenue trends: See daily sales charts for 7- and 30-day periods, or weekly summaries for 90 days.
  • Top 10 products: Find your best-selling products, with product thumbnails and links to view or edit them.
  • Product insights: Explore best- and worst-selling products, including catalog products with no sales in the selected period.
  • Category insights: See best- and worst-selling product categories.
  • Clear admin experience: Use a responsive dark-mode dashboard with a dedicated Smart Sales menu item.

Built for WooCommerce

  • Works with WooCommerce order data through its CRUD APIs and supports High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
  • Loads orders and catalog information in paginated AJAX batches.
  • Keeps different order currencies separate instead of adding unrelated monetary amounts together.
  • Restricts dashboard access to users with the manage_woocommerce capability.
  • Provides read-only analytics: the dashboard does not change your orders or products.

How the figures are calculated

  • Order sales include tax and shipping, minus refunds, for orders in statuses WooCommerce considers paid.
  • Orders are selected by their creation dates within the chosen period.
  • Product and category revenue includes item tax and item-level refund adjustments, but excludes shipping.
  • Net units sold account for refunded quantities.
  • Products may belong to multiple categories, so category totals can overlap.
  • Monetary values from different currencies are not combined without conversion.

Smart Sales Dashboard is intended to help you review store performance. Its figures can differ from other reports that use different date fields, order statuses, refund handling, or accounting definitions.

About SM DIGITAL

Smart Sales Dashboard is developed by SM DIGITAL, a digital studio focused on WordPress, WooCommerce, and practical software tools.

Learn more: smdigital.si
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New and search for Smart Sales Dashboard, or upload the plugin ZIP.
  3. Install and activate Smart Sales Dashboard.
  4. Open Smart Sales in the main WordPress admin menu.
  5. Select 7, 30, or 90 days to explore your store’s data.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce?

Yes. Smart Sales Dashboard reads WooCommerce orders and product information. WooCommerce must be active.

Is it compatible with HPOS?

Yes. The plugin uses WooCommerce CRUD APIs and declares HPOS compatibility.

Where do I find the dashboard?

After activation, open Smart Sales from the main WordPress admin menu. Access requires the manage_woocommerce capability.

Why do I see zero sales or empty product lists?

The dashboard displays data for the selected period. If your store has no matching paid orders or relevant products, some sections will be empty.

Why might totals differ from other WooCommerce reports?

The dashboard uses order creation dates and WooCommerce paid statuses. It accounts for refunds, and product/category revenue excludes shipping. Other reports may use different rules.

Does the plugin modify orders or products?

No. It reads WooCommerce information to display analytics and does not edit orders or products.

Does it combine sales from different currencies?

No. Amounts in different currencies are kept separate rather than added together without conversion.
